_comment: Copy to repos.json and fill real paths. repos.json is gitignored (local paths).
_resolve_order: overrides (array, first match) lock product repo/path → then branch via override/project versions → version_lines → branch_pattern → override/project default
_overrides_match: match.summary regex (?i). Prefer PC OVERLAY / CORTEX OVERLAY. Override sets repo/path; branch still follows branch_pattern unless versions/default says otherwise. Escape: /fix KEY overlay
_version_match: extract first x.y/.x.y.z from Jira name (e.g. V12.0 Public Release→12.0) → pad to x.y.z (12.0.0) → match versions keys (also padded) → version_lines longest prefix → branch_pattern
_branch_pattern: {version} = major.minor only, patch ignored (11.11.0/11.11.2→dev/11.11.x, 11.12→dev/11.12.x). Overlay same.
_version_lines: Prefix → inherit repo/path. After an override match, repo/path stay from override; only branch is derived unless override has its own version_lines.
_models: Optional per-agent model. Aliases: claude=opus|sonnet|fable; cursor=composer|grok (cursor default=grok). Full CLI ids also ok. Infra fallback claude→cursor uses models.cursor, else grok.
_review: Optional Review Gate (project + override only). Absent/enabled:false = off. Fields: enabled, agent, model, timeout_minutes, on_infra_fail(reject|skip). Runs after lint/test, before push. CLI: --review / --no-review.
